name: lean-comments
description: Stops Claude adding banner, multi-line, long or narrating code comments

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: block refuses the edit so Claude rewrites it; warn lets it through and tells Claude what to fix; off disables the mod.

maxLength.title: Max comment length
maxLength.description: Longest comment text allowed, in characters.

maxNewComments.title: Max new comments per change
maxNewComments.description: How many new comments one edit or write may add.

allowDocComments.title: Allow multi-line doc comments
allowDocComments.description: Let /** ... */ doc blocks span several lines, e.g. for a published library's public API.
